bundle.text:
# dsh-hold-to-talk bundle patch layer.
# 安装本包到 web profile 后,host 端加载主入口(长按语音输入:HTTP 路由 + 本地
# SenseVoice 识别引擎 + 设置命名空间)。浏览器半身由 dsh.client 声明,随页面加载。
#
# 下面 config 里的每一项都对应 host 侧 settings schema 的同名扁平字段;用户层
# (设置面板写 settings.yaml)优先级高于这里的 base 值。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-hold-to-talk
      name: dsh-hold-to-talk
      config:
        enabled: true
        # 长按判定:按住不动超过该毫秒数才进入录音(期间移动/选区/松手都算普通编辑)
        holdThresholdMs: 400
        # 按住后指针上移超过该像素数,进入"松开取消"态
        cancelSlidePx: 60
        # 边说边出字的间隔:每积累这么久的音频就重解码一次滑动窗口
        # (实测原生引擎解 6 秒窗口约 0.9 秒,1.5 秒一轮留有余量)
        interimIntervalMs: 1500
        # 短于该时长的录音直接丢弃(防误触)
        minHoldMs: 250
        # 单次长按最长时长,到点自动定稿
        maxHoldMs: 60000
        # 实时预览解码的滑动窗口上限(秒);松手定稿始终用完整音频
        maxWindowSec: 6
        # 定稿后是否自动发送;默认 false = 只写进输入框,由你自己按发送
        autoSend: false
        # SenseVoice 语言:auto / zh / en / ja / ko / yue
        language: auto
        # 逆文本规整(把"二零二六年"变成"2026年"这类)
        useItn: true
        numThreads: 2
        # 模型下载镜像(国内默认走 hf-mirror)
        mirror: https://hf-mirror.com
        # 模型缓存目录;留空 = ~/.dsh/hold-to-talk/models
        modelDir: ""

dsh-hold-to-talk turns your mouse into a microphone. It's a tiny helper for the DeepSeek Harness web composer. Instead of typing long messages, you simply hold your mouse button down on the input box, speak naturally, release the mouse, and your words appear as text. No coding, no complicated setup, no stickers or buttons needed.

**Here's the magic:**
- 🖱️ **Hold** your left mouse button on the text input area.
- 🗣️ **Speak** whatever you want to say(at your normal pace).
- ✍️ **Release** the mouse button—your words instantly appear in the text box.
.

---

All speech recognition happens **directly on your computer**. Your audio never travels to the internet or any server. It's completely offline,so you can dictate personal emails, private notes,or sensitive work messages without worrying about eavesdroppers.

.

No API keys,no monthly fees,no cloud credits.This tool uses a local AI model called SenseVoice (via sherpa-onnx) that runs right on your machine.It works even if your internet is down.The moment you release the mouse button, the text is ready.

.

This isn't a bloated suite of tools.It does one job and does it well: hold-to-talk voice input.The interface is minimal,so you won't waste time figuring out menus or settings.Just hold,speak,release.

.

readme.section: ❌ The floating window doesn't appear when I hold the mouse?
readme.text:
- Make sure the app is actually running. Check your system tray (bottom-right corner).If you see the icon,you're good. If not, go back to the extracted folder and double-click the app again.
.- **Restart your browser.** Sometimes a fresh browser session helps the app connect properly.

readme.section: 🎤 It's listening but my words don't show up?
readme.text:
- Speak **clearly at a normal volume**. No need to shout—just your regular speaking voice is perfect.
.- Make sure your microphone is **not muted** and is **selected as the default device** in Windows Sound settings.
.- If you're in a noisy environment, try moving closer to your microphoneor using a headset mic.

.

- First-time setup may take a few seconds to load the speech model. After that,it becomes faster. Give it about 10-20 seconds after the first launch before you try speaking. You'll see a "ready" notification from the tray icon when it's fully loaded.

.

This app is a "plugin" designed specifically for **DeepSeek Harness**. It integrates seamlessly—no extra windows to manage,no separate text boxes to copy from.Just hold, speak, release—and the words are in your draft. It's the same idea as "push-to-talk" in gaming, but for typing. Think of it like WeChat's voice message feature but for text input—dictation without the typing effort. It even keeps your thought flow uninterrupted because you're not switching between keyboard and mouse constantly.
